title: Observational Constraints and Cosmological Dynamics of Interacting Fractional Holographic Dark Energy in Light of DESI DR2 (Huang, Chen, Wu)
efc_relevance: Fractional HDE built from fractional quantum mechanics with three explicit DM–DE interaction kernels; statefinder + phase-space diagnostics against DESI DR2. Adds another node to the entropic/holographic-DE family EFC must outperform; the fractional-QM derivation gives a non-Boltzmann entropy floor that parallels EFC's information-entropy choice.
ledger_action: Add to entropic/holographic-DE comparator cluster; cross-reference framework:HolographicDE-Li2004, framework:KaniadakisHDE-Drepanou2021, arXiv:2604.19849, and arXiv:2605.16940; required head-to-head ΔAIC vs EFC on DESI DR2 background fit; flag statefinder-diagnostic row in WP3.
